title: Micius and China's quantum communication network
summary: Satellite and fibre quantum key distribution, operating at national scale.
bodyHtml:
What This Is

The Micius satellite, launched in 2016, demonstrated satellite-based quantum key distribution and entanglement distribution, and a 2,000km fibre link connects Beijing and Shanghai. A smaller satellite launched in 2022 extended the network, and China has reported intercontinental key exchange. QKD secures key distribution only; it does not encrypt stored data.

Status

Attribute Value
Development stage Early commercial
Estimated window 2016–2030
Confidence label Confident
Evidence Editorial synthesis of company, agency and press reporting
Compiled 18 November 2026

Related records

Investment Exposure

QKD is being deployed as infrastructure in China while Western enterprises lean toward post-quantum cryptography; both answers may coexist.

What Would Change The View

  • Cost per node versus PQC.
  • Commercial (non-state) adoption.
  • Interoperability with international standards.

Record Notes

Editorial brief, not an imported source note. Named milestones are drawn from company, agency and press reporting; forward dates are announced targets, not verified outcomes. No figure here is an audited statistic.
